content.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
content.description: Design an algorithm to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. Serialization is the process of converting a data structure into a sequence of bits so that it can be stored or transmitted and reconstructed later in the same or another computer environment.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 10^4]
Your serialization/deserialization algorithm should be stateless

examples.explanation: The tree is serialized to a string and then deserialized back to the original tree structure.

hints: Think about tree traversal methods (preorder, inorder, postorder)
How can you represent null nodes in your serialization?
Preorder traversal with null markers can uniquely identify a tree
Consider using a delimiter to separate values
follow_up_questions: How would you optimize for space if the tree is very sparse?
What if you needed to serialize multiple trees efficiently?
How would you handle very large trees that don't fit in memory?
Can you implement this iteratively instead of recursively?
